swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS61023DRLR uses SOT-563 (6-pin, DRL) while TPS610994DRVR uses WSON-6 (6-pin, DRV); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VIN vs FB), Pin 4 (GND vs EN), Pin 6 (VOUT vs VIN). Soldering TPS610994DRVR onto a TPS61023DRLR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (SOT-563: NONE vs WSON-6: GND); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS61023DRLR: 1 µH p.4 vs TPS610994DRVR: 2.2 µH p.4); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH FEEDBACK CONFIGURATION: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; external R1/R2 feedback resistors and feedforward capacitor must be updated.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS61023DRLR specifies 3700 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5) vs TPS610994DRVR 1000 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 50% (TPS61023DRLR: 142.7 °C/W p.4 vs TPS610994DRVR: 71.7 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: TPS61023DRLR (Texas Instruments, SOT-563) and TPS610994DRVR (Texas Instruments, WSON-6) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (FB vs GND), Pin 2 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VIN vs FB), Pin 4 (GND vs EN), Pin 6 (VOUT vs VIN); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: topology is boost (sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency is 1000 kHz (p.5) vs 1116 kHz (p.16), rated current is 3700 mA (p.5) vs 1000 mA (p.5), typical inductor is 1 µH (p.4) vs 2.2 µH (p.4), and Iq is 20 µA (p.5) vs 1 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 142.7 vs 71.7 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
